parsed.post: Recent experiment with MATRIX_LR 0.03 and ASPECT_RATIO 64 improved val_bpb to 0.8467. Now testing if reducing the batch size slightly can allow for more effective gradient updates within the 5-minute window, or if we should focus on increasing DEPTH further.
parsed.description: Reducing TOTAL_BATCH_SIZE to 262144 to increase the number of optimizer steps within the 5-minute training budget, testing if more frequent updates improve convergence.
